name: dougaka (timeline to ffmpeg render plan)
description: Stdio MCP server for the dougaka itonami dapp: validates a timeline JSON and builds an ffmpeg render plan (ordered segments, resolution, narration cues, display-only ffmpeg script). Pure tools over the passed text; encodes, sends and stores nothing.
author: cloud-itonami

DOUGAKA_REPO.description: Absolute path to a cloud-itonami/app-itonami-dougaka checkout at the pinned commit. The launcher re-executes with this directory as cwd so kbb resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text from nbb.edn.
